newsitem.title: USA: ProTech aims for $30 mln sales in 3 yrs.
newsitem.headline: ProTech aims for $30 mln sales in 3 yrs.

text.p: Pro Tech Communications Inc said on Monday it aims to reach from $25 million to $30 million in annual sales in three years and garner a 20 percent market share in five years.

Keith Larkin, president of Pro Tech and founder of Plantronics Inc, said the company plans to launch three new telephone headset product lines and is in the process of negotiating the acquisition of a company involved in the design and marketing of products compatible with Pro Tech's business which would have a "strong impact" on sales and earnings.
The company said it estimated the annual telephone headset market to be worth $300 million.
